name: Refrigerator Production Line Solution
summary: Full-line automation solution for refrigerator manufacturers, covering the entire process from assembly to packaging.
contentHtml:
The refrigerator production line solution is a full-line automation solution provided by TXAM for refrigerator manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The full line covers the entire process including component feeding, compressor installation, panel assembly, pipeline connection, electrical wiring, online inspection, vacuuming and refrigerant charging, automatic packaging, and intelligent palletizing.

Technical Advantages

  • High level of full-line automation, reducing reliance on manual labor
  • Flexible switching between multiple models, improving equipment utilization
  • Online inspection system to ensure product quality
  • Automated material handling with matched process cycle times
  • Intelligent data collection for lean production
  • Turnkey project service for one-stop delivery

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.
